question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
WITH order_item_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    o.ORDER_ID,
    COUNT(oi.ORDER_ITEM_ID) AS item_line_count,
    SUM(CAST(oi.QUANTITY AS FLOAT)) AS total_units
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.SOURCES.ORDERS o
  LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.SOURCES.ORDER_ITEMS oi
    ON o.ORDER_ID = oi.ORDER_ID
  WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY o.ORDER_ID
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN item_line_count = 0 THEN 'no_item_line'
    WHEN item_line_count = 1 THEN 'one_item_line'
    ELSE 'multi_item_line'
  END AS order_type,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  AVG(COALESCE(total_units,0)) AS avg_units_per_order
FROM order_item_counts
GROUP BY order_type
ORDER BY order_type;

action.metrics: order_count, avg_units_per_order, share of multi-line orders
action.answer: In 2025, among orders with at least one item line, 3,052,089 orders (70.01%) contained more than one item line (multi-line orders), while 1,307,684 orders (29.99%) had exactly one item line. No orders were found with zero item lines in the data. The average ordered units per order were 3.484769 for multi-line orders and 1.219753 for one-line orders. This shows that multi-line orders not only represent the majority but also have a significantly higher average quantity of items per order. Population: all 2025 orders in ZOMATO_DLR.SOURCES.ORDERS. Units: orders, units per order. No orders with zero item lines were observed.
action.reason: All requested values were derived from the query: order counts and average units per order by order type, and the share of multi-line orders was calculated as 3,052,089 / (3,052,089 + 1,307,684) = 70.01%. No 'no_item_line' orders were present in the results.
